description: Where is an item stocked? Returns on-hand, available and reserved per warehouse location (split by lot / expiry / serial for tracked items), plus the default location adjust_stock and move_stock use in each warehouse. Call this before adjust_stock, move_stock or reserve_stock to pick locations. Units committed to open sales orders are held per warehouse, not per location, so they are not taken out of a location's available here; list_items shows each warehouse's committed units and the available net of them.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) to narrow the result.

name: get_stock_locations
title: Stock Locations
